Use the full Muse Spark 1.3 token budget. Investigate tire transient response and carcass compliance as the source of the 'tires made of rock / no grip' feel. Focus on slip-angle relaxation, slip-ratio relaxation, lateral force relaxation, sidewall stiffness/deflection, vertical stiffness, wheel dynamics, low-speed handling transitions, and whether forces arrive too late or too abruptly. Preserve physical sign conventions. Do not solve this by arbitrary grip inflation. Inspect WheelDynamics.ts, TireModel.ts, m5G90.ts, Vehicle.ts, transient-response tests and low-speed cornering tests. If warranted, produce a scoped patch and deterministic transient/step-steer tests plus the strict M5 validation command.
